title: Alpha One — event order.paid v1
description: V1 catalog event `order.paid` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = LCC-05 (provisioning), LED-04 (payment capture posting), ANA-01. Derived from: docs/12 §3.2 (capture: intent captured → order paid) + docs/32 `orders` (id, amount_cents, currency, line_items{package_id}), `payment_intents` (provider, method), `provider_events` (provider_event_id); coupon per D75 (docs/62). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.

challenge_id.description: orders.line_items.package_id (frozen at submit — D42); the accounts.program_id / catalog 'challenge' ref LCC-05 provisions from

provider_event_id.description: provider_events(provider, provider_event_id) — the ingress idempotency key (EVT-10)

coupon_code.description: reserved at session (D75); null when no coupon
